paragraphs: I'm a **Computer Science & Engineering graduate** from the University of Asia Pacific with hands-on experience in Python, SQL, machine learning and data visualization. I finished a Data Science & Machine Learning with Python course in September 2026.

My ML projects go past the notebook. The **movie recommender** runs on a FastAPI backend with a Streamlit front end, and the **demand forecasting app** serves an XGBoost model with instant predictions. Both are live.
Before data science, I built robots. I contributed to a **Mars rover prototype** and the **RM22 IoT robot** on an ESP8266, and my research on vehicle-to-vehicle security led to two IEEE papers.
I'm looking for a data science or ML role where I can ship models people use and keep learning from a strong team.
